title: Fast walkers exempt from FOIA; Defense Support Program detections

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that "fast walkers," a term for very fast objects picked up by the Defense Support Program, a US military satellite system watching from high orbit, are still off limits under FOIA, a US law that lets anyone request government records. He says a researcher who files such requests, John Greenwald, tried and could not get them. If true, it would mean satellite records of strange fast objects are kept especially secret.
